youtube_title: Police Said 'Not Our Area'? Zero FIR Rule You Didn't Know #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #7. Your phone is stolen, you go to the police station and hear: 'Not our area, go there.' Do you go, or get the FIR written right there?
Answer: get it written there. It's called a Zero FIR. Under BNSS 2023 Section 173, information about a cognizable offence must be recorded irrespective of where the crime happened; the police then transfer it to the right station. If an officer still refuses, send your complaint in writing to the Superintendent of Police (Section 173(4)). You also get a free copy of the FIR (Section 173(2)).
Source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023, Section 173.

Phone chori hua, thane gaye, aur jawab mila: 'Yeh hamara area nahi hai' 😤 Wahan jaoge ya yahin FIR?
Sahi hai B — ZERO FIR. Naya law BNSS Section 173: crime kahin bhi hua ho, FIR likhni padegi, phir police sahi thane ko transfer karegi. Phir bhi mana karein toh SP ko likh ke shikayat bhejo (173(4)). Aur FIR ki FREE copy tumhara haq hai (173(2)).
